title: Sean McVay talks to assistants, says they will 'learn' after taunting incident with Eagles fans during comeback win

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay talks to assistants, says they will 'learn' after taunting incident with Eagles fans during comeback win
sources.description: Several Rams assistants were spotted pounding on the glass from their box and taunting Eagles fans during their comeback win on Sunday in Philadelphia.
